points.text: 1 discontinuous (forms / phenotypes / categories) distinct / discrete / categoric / do not overlap / do not form a (gradual) range / no intermediates / two or few different forms ; continuous (forms / phenotypes / categories) not distinct / not discrete / overlap / form a (gradual) range / include intermediates / many different forms / many values on a spectrum ;
2 discontinuous not a normal distribution / few bars (on bar chart) ; continuous normal distribution or normal / bell-shaped curve (on graph) ;
3 discontinuous no / little, effect from environment ; continuous some / large, effect from environment ;
2 different alleles of a gene have a large effect ;
3 egg size / diet of mother / size of mother ;
